name: Henry D. (Hank) Fellows, Jr.
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
about: Henry D. (Hank) Fellows, Jr. is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2027. He works at Fellows LaBriola, located in Atlanta, Georgia, and provides legal services for issues involving Business Litigation, Employment & Labor: Employer and Securities Litigation to the surrounding community.
Henry Fellows, Jr. completed legal studies at Georgetown University Law Center and graduated with the class of 1978. Henry Fellows, Jr. passed the bar in 1978.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
